import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os

# Suppress progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features and labels
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train["species"]
X_test = test[feature_cols]
test_ids = test["id"]

# Get unique species from training data
unique_classes = sorted(y_train.unique())
n_classes = len(unique_classes)
class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(unique_classes)}

# Hold-out validation split (30% for validation)
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Random Forest classifier with better hyperparameters
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=25,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    max_features="sqrt",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission with proper format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})

# Map species column names to probability columns
submission_species = sample_submission.columns[1:]
col_indices = [class_to_idx.get(spec, 0) for spec in submission_species]

# Create the probability columns by extracting 1D arrays from y_test_pred
for spec, idx in zip(submission_species, col_indices):
    if idx < n_classes:
        submission[spec] = y_test_pred[:, idx]
    else:
        submission[spec] = 0.0

# Ensure column order matches sample submission
submission = submission[sample_submission.columns]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
